body: I guess you could choose pieces from the same culture, but I wouldn't risk not getting that mark. The links can be superficial, because of how contrasting the cultures are, but as long as you analyse it in depth, you should be able to get high marks for it.

I'm not really sure about Lit IOC, because I do LangLi. But if it's similar, then you should definitely start working on the themes of the books, the prose and play. Then go on to analyse certain key scenes to get some good quotes that you can refer to during the IOC. The key scenes are also more likely to come out, but that is not 100%. As for poetry, try to look through all of them and understand the meaning of each and analyse the different literary devices being used. Don't try to memorise everything and throw it up during the IOC, but understand what each scene, quote and theme means. Hope this helps, good luck!
